title: Mobile map points were visually legible but pointer targets were only 2.58–8.79 CSS px
surface: Archive Archipelago parent explorer / narrow mobile map
tool: Workstation-bound Chromium 1243 + Accessible Publication peer review
workflow: 390x844 real browser measurement -> peer contract review -> source repair -> destructive touch/filter/pan tests -> mature web re-gate
symptom: At exact 390x844, all 303 SVG work marks measured below 24 CSS px; min=2.58, median=3.89, max=8.79. Pointer hit-testing therefore required near-pixel precision even though search provided a complete keyboard-equivalent route.
expected_behavior: Pointer/touch exploration should tolerate an imprecise tap without creating 303 giant overlapping semantic controls or selecting after horizontal pan.
actual_behavior: 303/303 direct SVG mark boxes were below 24px and below 44px in the mobile viewport.
proposed_fix: Keep SVG marks pointer/visual-only and the keyboard model unchanged. On background click after pointer-up, resolve the strict nearest currently-visible/non-dim node within <=22 CSS px; lexical Work-ID breaks exact ties. Suppress selection after >8 CSS px pointer displacement so panning remains a pan.
fix_attempt: Added nearestVisibleNode screen-space resolver, pointer-up capture, deterministic tie-break, visible-only filtering, and drag suppression. No giant hit circles or new ARIA/button semantics were added.
verification: Exact 390x844 Chromium destructive gates PASS: a 20px off-mark tap selected workstation:six-touch-nest even though a filtered/dim node was only 5.61px away; a 30px tap selected nothing; a >20px drag ending within the capture radius left selection unchanged; exact-ID keyboard reachability remained 303/303; map Tab stops remained O(1); page overflow=0; horizontal internal pan preserved; console errors=0. Mature Nu/axe/Chromium/Firefox gates re-PASS.
